name: H2T_PATH_VAULT
meaning: The vault root both sides read. Unset: ~/.dor/vault. Resolved by the pack, never spelled by POS.

name: h2t-ops paths get
meaning: One path per place, so POS asks instead of spelling it. secret:google.token is outside this entry: POS asks `h2t-ops google token` for the token itself.

name: h2t-ops google token

exit_codes.3: no token store on this machine

meaning: A valid access token, refreshed if needed, from this machine's token (4.0 store, else its 3.x files). POS asks; it does not read the pack's files (#584).

name: lake
meaning: Each connector writes only its own files under lake/<provider>/ and lists them in manifest.jsonl. POS reads; POS does not write there.

name: connector cursors
meaning: Sync position of granola and meetgeek. Pack-private: POS neither reads nor writes it, and asks the connector for messages since a cursor instead.
